description: Master instructed David to run 'npx -y @plaud-ai/mcp@0.3.14 login' for the Plaud MCP OAuth login. No 'login' CLI subcommand exists: the bin's only subcommands are (none, stdio server), install, install --yes/--no-login, http, and the deprecated setup. The command David ran started the stdio MCP server, which prints nothing and blocks on stdin, which he reported as 'it just sits there'.
correction: The OAuth login is reached via 'npx -y @plaud-ai/mcp@0.3.14 install' (runs OAuth inline, prints the URL if the browser does not open, listens on port 8199, 2-minute timeout), or by asking an MCP-connected client to call the 'login' tool. Gave David the corrected command.
systemic_fix: Before handing David a CLI command sourced from documentation prose, verify the subcommand exists in the installed package (inspect the bin's argv dispatch or run --help). Documentation summaries describe capabilities, not exact CLI surface; the package on disk is the authority.
